spells.name: Thicket Shield
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 3" of a terrain feature, it is not visible to enemy units more than 9" away.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Awaken the Carnivores
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls (friendly and enemy) while they are within 3" of the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Disrupt the Humours
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from contamination rolls and remediation rolls for the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Shifting Lands
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, enemy units cannot be set up within 12" of the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Healing Spiral
spells.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal(X)** the target, where **X** is the number of enemy models slain by combat attacks as part of that **^^Fight^^** ability.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Forest Walk
spells.effect: Double the caster's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
